title: Cataloging Cuttlefish
statement: Hovering through warm amber water filled with sunken brass astrolabes and softly swaying kelp, this pocket-sized cephalopod spends its days sorting colorful sea-glass into tidy, shimmering constellations. Whenever a visitor pauses by the glass, it ripples a quiet kaleidoscope of geometric light across its mantle like a polite, luminous hello.
